parameters.note: Buck Island Lake (El Dorado Co., GNIS Feature ID 219991) is a 39-acre lake at ~6,421 ft elevation in Eldorado National Forest, reached via the Rubicon Trail from Loon Lake, just outside the northern boundary of Desolation Wilderness. It is not listed by name in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) applies: open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
